author: reek
body: Rotating meshing gears, rasterized per pixel from Codex [Device] AST. Each gear is an implicit shape: a pixel is inside if its radius from the gear centre is below the tooth profile (a square wave of the polar angle) and outside the hub hole. Three gears of different tooth counts spin at speeds inversely proportional to their teeth and in alternating directions, so they mesh. The polar angle uses a rational atan2 (no atan2 intrinsic needed). Reference site's "gears" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.
